keyFindings.description: The open-fence probe finds the last line by the last \n only, but CommonMark (and micromark, and INFRA-529's drawDirective) also ends a line at a lone \r. A body using lone-\r line endings that is streaming a mermaid fence inside a quote or list item gets a probe line without the quote/list lead, the probe ends the container, the fence reads as closed, and the half-written diagram is drawn (a refusal flashed each frame). Reproduced: MarkdownBody.test.tsx's 'still open inside a quote' case with the quote body written with \r line endings fails at the head (expected 1 figure, got 2). Fix: take the last line after the last \n or \r, and add the \r case to that test.

No unit case puts a mermaid fence inside a ::: directive, which the merged INFRA-529 read-only parsing now draws. Both thermonuclear reviews measured the behaviour correct (31 and 15 bodies: open inside unclosed directive stays code, closed draws); a case `:::note` + open fence stays code and the same body closed draws would lock it in. Ask for it in this round, since the round already requests changes.
